recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied Jira resolution in the active MeasureReport source while preserving substantive Measure/MeasureReport interpretation guidance and avoiding broader CQI refactoring changes.
issue_request: FHIR-55366 was Applied/Persuasive for FHIR-core MeasureReport. CQI agreed that scoring, dataUpdateType, and improvementNotation do not meet the Is Modifier definition and directed removal of Is Modifier and the modifier reason for all three elements.
initial_application: Commit ddb69d6546fc083ea053d6483c86ac8a6b0d4643 partially applied the issue by changing MeasureReport.dataUpdateType, MeasureReport.group.scoring, and MeasureReport.group.improvementNotation from isModifier=true to isModifier=false, but it left the isModifierReason elements and a group.improvementNotation comment saying the element was labeled as a modifier.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists MeasureReport, so source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml is in current build scope. Related MeasureReport changes mean scoring and improvementNotation are currently group-level elements, and FHIR-49670's Measure-to-MeasureReport interpretation guidance should be preserved even though the obsolete modifier assertion is removed. Targeted Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community discussion.
reconciliation: The published commit removes explicit isModifier=false and isModifierReason entries from MeasureReport.dataUpdateType, MeasureReport.group.scoring, and MeasureReport.group.improvementNotation, and removes the stale 'labeled as a modifier' sentence from the group.improvementNotation comment. Unrelated status modifier metadata was left intact.
source_changes: source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml: removed isModifier and isModifierReason metadata from MeasureReport.dataUpdateType, MeasureReport.group.scoring, and MeasureReport.group.improvementNotation.

source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml: removed the stale modifier-label sentence from MeasureReport.group.improvementNotation while preserving the rest of the interpretation guidance.
